title: NULL key value causes json_group_object returns incorrect result with window function
repro_sql:
WITH t(id,k,v) AS (
  VALUES
    (1,NULL,'skip'),
    (2,'a',1),
    (3,'b',2)
),
actual AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    json_group_object(k,v) OVER (
      ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS json_win,
    json(jsonb_group_object(k,v) OVER (
      ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )) AS jsonb_win
  FROM t
),
expected AS (
  SELECT
    o.id,
    (
      SELECT json_group_object(i.k,i.v)
      FROM t AS i
      WHERE i.id BETWEEN o.id-1 AND o.id
    ) AS json_expected,
    (
      SELECT json(jsonb_group_object(i.k,i.v))
      FROM t AS i
      WHERE i.id BETWEEN o.id-1 AND o.id
    ) AS jsonb_expected
  FROM t AS o
)
SELECT
  a.id,
  a.json_win,
  e.json_expected,
  a.jsonb_win,
  e.jsonb_expected
FROM actual AS a
JOIN expected AS e USING(id);
